steps.name: library_bin
steps.query: select count(*) from resolved_edge where caller_name = 'library_target_probe' and callee_name = 'bin_helper' and caller_path like '%/rust_visibility/app/src/lib.rs' and callee_path like '%/app/src/bin/0_tool.rs'
